project.name: IKE Platform
project.description: Consumer-facing parent POM, BOM, and workspace management plugin for the IKE Network. External doc and code projects inherit from ike-parent (declared here); cross-repo workspace operations use ike-workspace-maven-plugin (ws:* goals). Consumes ike-docs as an external artifact — ike-parent declares ike-doc-maven-plugin with extensions=true, resolving from Nexus at project-load time. Split from the archived ike-pipeline; see IKE-Network/ike-issues#216.

configuration.top: IKE Pipeline › ${project.name} › API Docs

requireMavenVersion.message: IKE projects require Maven 4+. Download: https://maven.apache.org/download.cgi

requireJavaVersion.message: IKE projects require Java 21+ (JRuby 10 baseline). macOS: brew install openjdk Ubuntu: sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk

evaluateBeanshell.message:
ike-issues#383 — inherited <distributionManagement><site><url> points to the in-reactor location and was not overridden.
project.groupId: ${project.groupId} effective site.url: ${project.distributionManagement.site.url}
External consumers of ike-parent must declare their own site URL:
<distributionManagement> <site> <id>ike-site</id> <url>https://ike.network/${project.artifactId}/</url> </site> </distributionManagement>
See ike-parent/CLAUDE.md ("Inheriting projects MUST declare their own <distributionManagement><site>") for the rationale and the ike-issues#380 background.
